lines.desc: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of variable speed pumping system consisting of Horizontal Endsuction pump with stardelta starter controlled by dedicated microprocessor based pump logic controller with Modbus communication mounted separately in a control panel. The pump shall be driven by TEFC induction motor of class `F' insulation & IE 3 rating shall be considered for the pump motor energy & efficiency suitable for operation on 415 volts ±10%, 3 phase, 50 Hz A.C. supply. Panel mounted micro - processor based multi pump controller with VFD should also have provision for automatic alternate (cyclic) operation of pumps, multiple differential pressure sensor/ transmitters as necessary, ON/OFF push buttons, selection of pumps mode on panel, adequate provision to terminate aluminum armounred power cable as incomer to controller incomer, earth terminations complete as per specification. The system shall be complete in all respect and suitable for following rating. The Pump shall be with vibration isolator as per OEM standard and proper pipe support arrangement shall be considered to avoid any kind of pump operation vibration issues.
